test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

Statement - I: Dobereiner made the first observations on platinum as a catalyst and discovered similar triads of elements which led to the development of the periodic table of elements.

Statement - II: JW Dobereiner was the professor of chemistry and pharmacy at the University of Jena.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Both the statements are true.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Johann Wolfgang Dobereine**r (1780-1849) observed platinum's catalytic properties

 
 
• He identified "**triads" of elements** with similar chemical properties, such as:

 
 
• Calcium (Ca), Strontium (Sr), Barium (Ba)
 
• Lithium (Li), Sodium (Na), Potassium (K)
 
• Chlorine (Cl), Bromine (Br), Iodine (I)
 
 
 
• These **triads showed regular patterns** in atomic weights and chemical behaviour.
 
• Dobereiner's work laid the groundwork for the development of the periodic table.
 
• Hence statement 1 is true. 
 
 
 
• **Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner **was a German chemist.
 
 
• He held the** position of professor of chemistry and pharmacy** at the University of Jena (Germany).
 
• This **academic affiliation facilitated his research and teaching.**
 
• Hence statement II is also true
